notes: v317 fixes four Cold Glue staging authority defects. Equal-length inside/outside brush channels now hold the bottle at 90 degrees through both the channel entrance and exit so animation cannot interpolate away from the red centerline. Explicit Aggregate and Station Setup selections remain authoritative before objects are added and are no longer collapsed by gripper-sequence normalization. An enabled aggregate's mapped spender position is accepted as the application centerline reference, removing the false missing Gripper / Spender Plate warning. Build Inputs now lists all brands, while APL/Cold Glue catalog metadata no longer replaces or regenerates the active build recipe. The v316 full-neck-wrap overlap and seam-wipe policy remains active.
